Comment: Serverless image processing pipeline: resize an uploaded image to a thumbnail, then report success or failure.

ResizeImage.Comment: Invoke the image resize Lambda function.

RecordUnexpectedError.Comment: Turn an unhandled error (timeout, crash) into the same result shape the Lambda returns.

WasResizeSuccessful.Comment: Check whether the image resizing was successful.

ResizeSucceeded.Comment: Thumbnail was written to the resized-images bucket.

ResizeFailed.Comment: Image could not be resized. See the execution history and Lambda logs in CloudWatch.
ResizeFailed.Cause: The image could not be resized. Check the execution input/output and the Lambda CloudWatch logs.
